svg.title: Turning egocentric human video into robot training data
svg.desc: Photos from EgoScale. A person wears a head-mounted camera that records first-person video of their hands. A hand pose estimation model labels 3D wrist and finger keypoints in each frame. The hand trajectory over time becomes the action label, optionally retargeted to the robot hand first. Video frames and actions form observation-action pairs that are co-trained with robot demonstrations.
